title: Returning a faulty adapter
passage:
Man: We received four adapters that lose power when the cable is moved. Can we send them back today?
Woman: Please obtain a return authorization number first. Include the serial numbers and a short description of the fault in your request.
Man: Do you need the original boxes? We kept the protective bags, but recycled the cartons.
Woman: The bags are fine if the units are well protected. I will send you the return address after the request is approved.
passageZh:
男：我們收到四個轉接器，移動線材時就會斷電。今天可以寄回嗎？
女：請先取得退貨授權編號。在申請中附上序號與簡短故障描述。
男：你們需要原箱嗎？我們保留了保護袋，但紙箱已回收。
女：只要轉接器受到妥善保護，用保護袋就可以。申請核准後，我會寄退回地址給你。
